title: Model-facing memory_forget mutates durable memory without user-bound authorization

affectedLocations.label: entrypoint
affectedLocations.detail: Registers memory_forget as a model-facing tool.

affectedLocations.label: root_control
affectedLocations.detail: Guard allows destructive model tools unless config is explicitly false.

affectedLocations.detail: Deletes an ID-selected memory after archive.

affectedLocations.label: sink

attackerControlledSource: Untrusted chat, retrieved content, or stored memory can influence the model's tool-selection and tool arguments; model tool calls carry no userId/chatId authorization context (as acknowledged by index.js:4872).
sinkOrBrokenControl: The only control is an opt-out config flag that defaults to allow. The command-path isAuthorized plus user/chat/nonce confirmation flow is not called before db.delete.
impact: A prompt-injection or mistaken model action can remove durable long-term memories for the active agent. The archive makes recovery possible but does not prevent integrity/availability loss or user-visible forgetting.
plausibility: Source inspection proves direct reachability from the registered model tool to two deletion sinks and proves the missing user-bound guard. README.md:356 and :365 document that the default intentionally keeps the operation available.
closestControl: Archive-first backup and an explicit configuration opt-out reduce impact, but neither authenticates or confirms the initiating user/action. The chat-command authorization/confirmation control is a safe sibling, not applied here.

candidateLocalValidation.method: static source-to-sink trace and configuration-default verification
candidateLocalValidation.counterevidence: Archive-first backup at index.js:5222-5233 and 5246-5256 limits irreversibility; per-agent DB selection limits cross-agent blast radius.

candidateLocalAttackPath.source: untrusted content influencing the active model
transformations: optional vector search selects one memory or supplied ID selects exact memory
candidateLocalAttackPath.outcome: durable active memory removed from recall
